title: coordinate-ttl-prefetch-and-adaptive-retry-with-resumable-async-iterables-across-sdks
author: Monica Reyes
release_notes: Small SDK surface changes: unify credential TTL handling, introduce adaptive retry presets, add resumable async-iterable helpers for streaming and bump SDK versions (py 3.9.5 -> 3.10.0, ts 1.27.3 -> 1.28.0, go v1.5.2 -> v1.6.0). No breaking API changes for typical callers; migration notes included.
description: Motivation: We have continuing drift in how each language SDK handles short-lived credentials and retry backoff defaults for streaming calls. Customers using multi-language stacks see inconsistent reconnect behavior and duplicate connection attempts during auth refresh windows. This PR coordinates a cross-SDK implementation to: 1) introduce a small credential TTL prefetch window (configurable, default 15s) that triggers a non-blocking refresh; 2) expose adaptive retry presets (fast/steady/conservative) which surface the same parameters across Python, TypeScript, and Go; 3) add a lightweight resumable async-iterable helper for streaming consumers that supports checkpointing and resume-after-refresh without duplicating payloads. Implementation notes: - Python: added redwood.streaming.resume.AsyncResumableIterator and a small CredentialsWatcher that emits non-blocking refresh signals; integrated with existing retry profiles via new retry_presets enum. Backcompat: existing StreamClient iterators now opt into resumable behavior via resume_on_auth_refresh=True. - TypeScript: added resumeStreamForAuth() helper and exported RetryPresets type with same numeric params as other SDKs; ensured async-generator ergonomics and backpressure hint passthrough. - Go: introduced stream.CheckpointIterator and a CredentialPrefetcher that runs alongside existing session renewal logic; provided examples for context-aware iteration using contexts for cancellation. Cross-cutting: unified telemetry tags for auth_refresh events (sdk.auth.refresh.*) and added small e2e streaming tests that exercise auth near expiry and verify at-most-once semantics for resumed streams. This description includes the checklist and examples below. Checklist: - [x] design doc linked in Linear ENG-1182 - [x] python + ts + go tests added - [x] docs updated with migration guidance - [x] define default prefetch window and make configurable - [x] bump SDK versions and changelogs - [x] add telemetry events for refresh/retry decisions Related: SUP-4521 (customer reported double-reconnect during token rotation).
